glossary.definition: (A) "Political subdivision" includes municipal corporation, township, and taxing district.
glossary.scope: As used in section 505.23 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Insurance" means insurance coverage, including group insurance, as provided in standard casualty insurance policies.
glossary.scope: As used in section 505.23 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (C) "Volunteer firemen" means all members in good standing of the volunteer fire department of such political subdivision.
glossary.scope: As used in section 505.23 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (D) "Accident and death benefits" means such benefits as are provided in standard casualty insurance policies.
glossary.scope: As used in section 505.23 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (E) "Line of duty" includes such duties as are prescribed by the rules and regulations of such volunteer fire department.
